sections.description: We are looking for a Technical Lead / Architect to own the end-to-end design and delivery of our AI-powered recruitment platform. The role requires strong backend architecture skills, hands-on experience with LLM integration, and the ability to lead a cross-functional engineering team.
sections.title: Role Overview

sections.bullet_points:
Own backend architecture and system design decisions for the recruitment platform
Lead and mentor a cross-functional engineering team
Design and integrate AI agent pipelines for real-time interview assistance
Define and enforce API contracts, data models, and service boundaries
Collaborate with product and recruiter stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
Ensure system reliability, scalability, and security across all services
sections.title: Responsibilities

sections.bullet_points:
8+ years of backend software engineering experience
Proven experience as a Technical Lead or Architect on SaaS platforms
Strong system design skills — distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architecture
Hands-on experience with LLM integration and AI agent orchestration
Proficiency in Python and/or Golang
PostgreSQL and database performance optimization
Experience with ERPNext / Frappe is a strong plus
Familiarity with real-time systems (WebSockets, streaming, VAD)
sections.title: Requirements

sections.bullet_points:
Experience building ATS or recruitment technology platforms
Knowledge of pgvector, semantic search, or embeddings
Exposure to multi-agent systems or AI pipeline design
Previous product ownership or technical leadership in a startup environment
sections.title: Nice to Have

sections.bullet_points:
System Design
AI Agents
Recruitment Systems
Software Engineering
Technical Strategy
Team Management
